Carried nit · 2026-11-18T04:54Z

Contract review 6969452030 on PR #35065 (N5, nit) names this card as its carrier: on the shared replay list, when another object's dataset declares `dependsOn` an object whose fallback choice is refused, and the organization's locale is one no set lists, the whole load is refused (every package's rows for that organization) until restart. The same list without the marker is refused the same way, so it is a property of the append-only list this card covers, not of the `fallback` key. Recorded here so the fix for this card also checks that composition.
